senses.sense_definition: The belief that war and violence are morally wrong and should not be used to settle disputes between countries.

examples.text: Many people turned to <w>pacifism</w> after witnessing the terrible destruction caused by the global conflict.
His commitment to <w>pacifism</w> meant he refused to participate in any military actions during the war.

senses.sense_definition: The ethical practice of avoiding the infliction of harm on others in everyday life.

examples.text: Her personal <w>pacifism</w> extended to her diet and how she treated every living creature she encountered.
Practicing <w>pacifism</w> in daily life requires a deep level of patience and self-control when dealing with others.

senses.sense_definition: A challenge in video games where a player must complete the game without harming any enemy characters.

examples.text: The player attempted a <w>pacifism</w> run to see if it was possible to finish the game without combat.
Completing the game using <w>pacifism</w> is considered a difficult achievement by the gaming community.
